0.body: Synechocystis ihabhakitiriya inoita fotosintitesi isina nyukiliyasi. Inogara nechiedza: inoburitsa oxyjeni pamaskamu ayo, isina mabhloroplastic. Mulabhoratori ndiyo muenzaniso wekuedza kwehydrojeni.

1.body: Anabaena variabilis ndiyo tambo yemaseli. Maseli amwe anova maheterokisiti anobata nitrojeni, vavakidzani vachigadzira shuga. Mudziva inopa nitrojeni yakabatwa.

2.body: Spirulina (Arthrospira) inhete yemaseli ine vesicles gasi. Inomira pedyo nedhrombhira yemvura, inoita fotosintitesi, uye inodyiwa. Mumtambo ndiyo skuru guru girini pafilemu yemvura.

3.body: Nostoc punctiforme ndiyo tambo yemabhandishi mukanzuru yemukaka. Inogara yokega kana mubatanidzwa nezvirimwa. Boka racho rinofanana nokuwanza kwemabhandichi girini.

4.body: Oscillatoria limnetica ndiyo tambo inoyandutsa. Inotambanuka kurudyi nekuchamhembe uye inogona kuita fotosintitesi isingaburitse oxyjeni. Inowanikwa mudhavhe nepamusoro pemvura.

5.body: Microcystis aeruginosa iboka remaseli remukaka, kazhinji rine toiksini (microcystin). Ndoyo inokonzera uwandu hwemadhrai pamusoro pemvura. Mumtambo ibhora girini reboka, chikafu chine njodzi.

6.body: Gloeocapsa maseli mabili muzvikwama zvane ruvara. Anogara pamatombo nedhaga uye anogona kumira UV. Mudziva makokisi madiki mabili mukanzuru.

7.body: Lyngbya majuscula tambo hombe yebhakitiriya inoita fotosintitesi. Inogona kuburitsa toiksini dzinokwesha. Inomisa uta hwemadhrai pedyo nemagombe anopisa.

8.body: Chlamydomonas reinhardtii seli girini ine maflajela maviri nedziso rechiedza. Inoshanda ichiona chiedza. Ndiyo muenzaniso wekare mujenetiki yemadhrai.

9.body: Chlorella vulgaris bhora girini risingafambi. Rinopatsanurwa zvakurumidza uye rine protein yakawanda. Chikafu chezvidiki, uye vanoishandisa muongororo yechikafu chokunze kwenyika.

10.body: Volvox globator bhora guru rogwenya rakagadzirwa nemaseli chiwumbazana. Maboka emadzimai anokura mukati mebhora obuda. Mumtambo ndiro boka guru girini.

11.body: Euglena gracilis inodya nzira mbiri: ine mabhloroplastic uye inogona kudya chikafu. Dziso tsvuku rinotevedza chiedza. Girini masikati; murusvongo chinoshandura kuenda kuchikafu.

12.body: Scenedesmus quadricauda kazhinji maseli mana mumutsara neminzwa pakugumira. Minzwa inoremedza kunywa. Haigoni kuhibha — inoyandutswa nemvura.

13.body: Haematococcus pluvialis seli girini inofamba; mukutambudzwa inova tsvuku (astaxanthin) uye inokura huswa hukobvu. Mazistse tsvuku anopfuurira zhara yemvura.

14.body: Dunaliella salina haina huswa hukobvu uye inogara mumvura ine munyu zvakanyanya. Inochengeta beta-carotene uye inoonekwa seyorengi. Ine maflajela maviri.

15.body: Micrasterias rotata ndiyo desmidi yakatambarara senyenyeri. Zvikamu zviviri zvakanangana zvine kudyara kwakadzika. Haifambi; inoita fotosintitesi mumvura yemabhogu ine asidi.

16.body: Navicula ndiyo diatomu yechikeche ine goko resilika. Inoyanduka pachishandiswa ichitevedza mbondera yeraphe. Goko rinoshuma mushure pokufa.

17.body: Pinnularia viridis ndiyo diatomu hombe yepennate. Goko resilika rine mufananidzo wakarongeka. Inoyanduka zvishoma pasi pe.

18.body: Cyclotella meneghiniana diatomu yakadenderedzwa. Inoyanduka sedhaisi; goko ndiro zvidayo zviviri. Plankton inozivikanwa.

19.body: Diatoma vulgare diatomu dzinobatana muzigizagi. Boka rarwo rinowedzera mhirizhonga mumvura.

20.body: Rhodospirillum rubrum spiral tsvuku. Fotosintitesi isingaburitse oxyjeni pamwe neorgani. Ruvara rutsvuku runobva mubhakterioklorofili.

21.body: Chromatium vinosum bhakitiriya tsvuku yesulfur. Inoshandura hydrogen sulfide uye inochengeta magraini esulfur. Inogara pamuganhu weoxyjeni nesulfur.

22.body: Porphyridium cruentum alga tsvuku yausel wega. Phycoerythrin inopa ruvara rutsvuku seropa. Kanzuru yemukaka, isina maflajela.

23.body: Prochlorococcus marinus ndiyo seli diki kupindura dzose dzinoita fotosintitesi, uye inowanda kupindura dzose pasi pano. Yakaonekwa muma1980. Ndoyo inodyetsa gungwa.

24.body: Chroococcidiopsis thermalis inogara munzvimbo dzakaoma: dhizerti, matombo, mhedesi (radiation). Ndiyo imwe yakanangana nehupenyu kunze kwenyika. Mudziva boka rechikokisi chakanyanyisa kuredza.

25.body: Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus bhakitiriya diki inodya dzimwe. Inopinda mukati meseli yemumwe bhakitiriya, ikawanda kusvika seli yabvaruka.

26.body: Vampirococcus inomira pachikafu chayo kunze, inomwa zviri mukati isiri kupinda. Ndiyo bhakitiriya inomwa ropa.

27.body: Daptobacter inopinda mubhakitiriya chikafu chayo ichidya mukati. Muvhigi mukati meseli akashoma.

28.body: Myxococcus xanthus bhakitiriya yebatanidzwa. Mutsumi inatenderedza chikafu uye inoburitsa maenzaimu. Pa chikafu chisina inova mutumbi wemichero.

29.body: Bacteriovorax stolpii hanzvadzi yemugungwa yaBdellovibrio. Inorwisa Gram-negative uye inogara muperiplasm yechikafu.

30.body: Halobacteriovorax muvhigi webhakitiriya unogona mumunyu. Njira imwecheteyo: kushura huswa nekukura mukati.

31.body: Peredibacter starrii mumwe muvhigi waBALO. Inokurumidza, yakaita sekoma, inorwisa mabhakitiriya hombe dzakaita semiti.

32.body: Monas guttula flajelate diki inodya organi. Inobata bhakitiriya pamusoro pedetritusi.

33.body: Oikomonas termo flajelate yakaita sedonhwe. Flajera imwe; inovhiga mufirimu yemabhakitiriya.

34.body: Anthophysa vegetans boka pachimuti cheiron-manganeze. Maseli anogara mutsumi anobata bhakitiriya.

35.body: Chilomonas paramecium cryptophyte isina ruvara. Maflajela maviri; inodya organi dzakanyunguduka nebhakitiriya diki, isina mabhloroplastic.

36.body: Cercomonas longicauda amoeboflajelate yakareba kumashure. Inofamba ichimepa bhakitiriya nepseudopodia.

37.body: Heteromita globosa flajelate yedhaga. Maflajela maviri akasiyana kureba; ndiyo inonyanya kudya bhakitiriya mudhaga.

38.body: Bodo saltans kinetoplastid. Inodzana panzvimbo imwe, yakabatana neflajera yekumashure, uye inobata bhakitiriya.

39.body: Procryptobia sorokini hanzvadzi yaBodo. Inofamba yokoga uye inorwisa chikafu neflajera yekumberi.

40.body: Trypanosoma brucei paramita yemaropa inokonzera indwara yokuzorora zvakanyanya. Ine memburani inofamba neflajera imwe. Mudziva ndiyo muenzaniso wevhigi wakatetepa.

41.body: Leishmania donovani paramita yemunhu inogara mukati meseli. Ine flajera muzvipukanana; isina flajera mukati memacrophage.

42.body: Monosiga brevicollis choanoflagellate, hama yezvipukanana. Kolari yemicrovilli inosunga bhakitiriya.

43.body: Salpingoeca rosetta choanoflagellate isingafambi iri mulorica. Inogona kuva rosette. Inosunga mvura inoyerera.

44.body: Codonosiga botrytis boka rechoanoflagellate pachimuti chimwecheteyo. Zvinosunga zvizhinji pachimuti chimwe.

45.body: Paramecium caudatum ndiyo shangu yakajairwa. Ine macilia mazhinji, mugwamwa wemukanwa, nemavhakuoli ekumanikidza. Inosunga bhakitiriya.

46.body: Paramecium bursaria shangu ine zuchlorella. Girini mukati: shuga kubva mualgae masikati, kusunga husiku.

47.body: Stentor coeruleus ndiyo trompeti yebluu kusvika kumilimita imwe. Inovhura yakaita sedhaisi, ichimanikidza mvura nemacilia. Inogona kushanda kana kugara.

48.body: Stentor polymorphus hanzvadzi yaStentor yebluu, kazhinji ine zuchlorella. Chiumbiko chacho chinoshandura kubva patorompeti kusvika pabhora.

49.body: Vorticella campanula ndiyo beere pachitanda chinokweshwa. Chitanda chinomonyorwa kuita spiral ipapo sahizha. Seli pachayo haifambi ichibuda.

50.body: Vorticella microstoma beere diki. Chitanda chokukweshwa chimwe chete, mugwamwa wemukanwa wutetepa. Kazhinji padetritusi.

51.body: Didinium nasutum barika muvhigi wemasangu. Inopfuridza toksisiti uye inomepa chikafu chose, kana chikuru kupindura iyo.

52.body: Spirostomum ambiguum sigara refu zvakanyanya. Inomanikidzwa kakawanda muzvikamu zvesekondi. Macilia anotevedza spiral.

53.body: Blepharisma americanum ciliati yepinki. Pigimindi blepharismin inotyora chiedza. Inosunga uye inogona kurwisa maseli madiki.

54.body: Euplotes patella inofamba pacirri semapedsu. Yakatambarara, kushanduka kwazvo zvikurumidza. Inokwesa bhakitiriya pamusoro pezvinhu.

55.body: Stylonychia pustulata hypotrich inorwisa pasi pe. Ciriri hombe, mukanwa wakajeka. Muvhigi wamacili madiki.

56.body: Oxytricha trifallax muenzaniso wejenomu: nyukiliyasi mbiri nekuchinjwa kweDNA kunorerama. Inofamba pacirri, inodya bhakitiriya maprotisti madiki.

57.body: Tetrahymena thermophila ciliati yelabhoratori. Membranelles mana emukanwa, kupatsanurwa zvikurumidza. Muenzaniso wetelomere nemacilia.

58.body: Coleps hirtus barika mupleyiti ekalesiyamu ane minzwa. Inodya zvakafa uye inovhiga: inokweva zvinorwadziwa.

59.body: Litonotus lamella muvhigi wakatambararira ane toksisiti mumhoro. Inomhatapira chikafu ichimwa zvarimo.

60.body: Dileptus anser mutsipa murefu une extrusomes dzine toiksini. Anorwisa nemutsipa, obva amedza. Muvhigi hombe wepakati.

61.body: Urocentrum turbo seli inodonha panzvimbo: bhandi remacili epakati inodonhedza seli pachayo. Inosunga bhakitiriya.

62.body: Zoothamnium arbuscula boka rakavadzwa mabele. Chitanda chimwe chakabatana chinokangaidza muti wose ipapo sahizha.

63.body: Opercularia coarctata peritrich isingafambi isina chitanda chokukweshwa. Chivharo chinovhara mukanwa. Inosunga uye haibudi.

64.body: Amoeba proteus ndiyo amiba yakajairwa. Pseudopodia inozvitenderedza chikafu. Isina chiumbiko chakadzikama, isina macilia.

65.body: Arcella vulgaris amiba ine goko rakasimba rakaumbwa sedhomo. Pseudopodia inobuda mugwanwa. Inofamba pazvirimwa.

66.body: Difflugia oblonga ine goko rakagadzirwa nemadhonha ejecha. Inogara mudhavhe.

67.body: Euglypha alveolata ine goko remakeyi esilika. Pseudopodia diki tete. Ndiyo muvhigi diki webhakitiriya.

68.body: Nebela collaris goko rebhodhoro rakagadzirwa nemakeyi akabirwa. Mvura yemasango nemabhogu.

69.body: Centropyxis aculeata goko redhaisi rine minzwa. Mugwanwa uri kudivi. Inofamba padetritusi.

70.body: Actinophrys sol heliozoan: axopodia diki anotenderedza nzvimbo dzose. Chikafu chinobatirira pamarwazi obva apinswa mukati.

71.body: Actinosphaerium eichhorni heliozoan hombe ine nyukiliyasi mazhinji. Marwazi emufananidzo, seli hombe zvikuru. Inodya macili nerotifere.

72.body: Raphidiophrys pallida heliozoan mumakeyi. Marwazi ane netsinga yesilika. Muvhigi weplankton anorindira.

73.body: Rotaria rotatoria rotifer inogona kupfuurira yoma. Korona inotumira chikafu mukanwa. Chisikwa chazvino chimwe chine maseli mazhinji.

74.body: Philodina roseola rotifer yeBdeloidi pinki. Inofamba pasi uye inogonawo kushavha. Hadzisi chete; asina varume.

75.body: Brachionus plicatilis rotifer yeLoricate iplanktoni. Chikafu chemacheche emafi mukurima kwemafi. Inosunga alge nebhakitiriya.

76.body: Keratella cochlearis rotifer ine minzwa yeLorica mirefu. Minzwa inovhimbisa vhigi. Plankton inowanzwa mudziva.

77.body: Asplanchna priodonta hembe isina Lorica, rotifer muvhigi. Inomepa dzimwe rotifere nemacili ose.

78.body: Chaetonotus maximus gastrotrich. Wakavharwa nemakeyi, inofamba pasi pe. Inodya bhakitiriya nedetritusi.

79.body: Lepidodermella squamata gastrotrich diki wakavharwa nemakeyi anodzerana. Kushandura kwazvo zviri mukati mekukurumidza.

80.body: Macrostomum lignano nyoka yakatetepa inoonekwa ne microscope. Ine masel-e-muviri echokwadi nemaziso. Muenzaniso wekugadziriswa zve. Inovhiga maprotisti madiki.

81.body: Stenostomum leucops nyoka yakatetepa ine macilia. Inopatsanurwa kuita chuma chemazoid. Muvhigi wedetritusi nezvisikwa zvidiki.

82.body: Microstomum lineare nyoka yakatetepa inodya hidra uye inoisira masel adzo ekurwadzisa muganda rayo. Chuma chemazoid.

83.body: Prostoma graecense nemertean yemvura chena. Mhoro murefu inopfurira chikafu. Muvhigi hombe pasi pe, akashoma.

84.body: Trichoplax adhaerens placozoan, wezvisikwa zvakapusa. Inofamba sebepa uye inaya chikafu kunze. Isina mukanwa.

85.body: Saccharomyces cerevisiae yasti yechingwa. Inodya shuga, inoburitsa CO2 nedoro. Mudziva inochenesa organi dzakanyungudika.

86.body: Candida albicans yasti inogona kukura semitande. Paramita yemunhu inorwisa paine hutano hushoma. Mumtambo fungusi yedetritusi.

87.body: Mucor mucedo fungusi wechingwa. Sporangia pachitanda, kukurumidza kukura pazvakafa. Haivhigi zvipenyu.

88.body: Rhizopus stolonifer fungusi tema wechingwa. Stolons nerhizoids dzinoparira pasi pe substrate. Inopatsanura starch.

89.body: Penicillium chrysogenum fungusi webhurashi, sosi yepenicillini. Mabhurashi emakonidiya. Inoputsa organi uye inodzikisa bhakitiriya iri pedyo.

90.body: Aspergillus niger aspergillusi tema. Mitwe yespure dzakadenderedzwa. Inogadzira citric acid yemafakitari. Saprotroph.

91.body: Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis chitiridi chefrogi. Zospore dzine flajera imwe. Mudziva muenzaniso wefungusi wemvura.

92.body: Chytriomyces aureus chitiridi chemvura che pollin ne alge. Sporangia zendarama; zospore dzinoshanda ku substrate.

93.body: Allomyces macrogynus fungusi wemvura une mycelium chaiwo. Unotsanangura diploid ne haploid. Zospore dzine flajera yekumashure.

94.body: Bacillus subtilis bhakitiriya yedhaga yakaita semuti. Spore dzinogona kupfuurira kufashira kwemvura. Inopatsanura protein; muenzaniso weGram-positive.

95.body: Pseudomonas putida bhakitiriya yekuchenesa. Inodya kunyange zvinobva mupetroleum. Ine flajera, inokurumidza kukura padetritusi.

96.body: Streptomyces coelicolor bhakitiriya yedhaga yakaita semiti. Inogadzira munhuvi wedhaga (geosmin) ne antibiotics mazhinji. Spure pahyphae.

97.body: Cellulomonas fimi inopatsanura cellulose. Bhakitiriya yeyelo yakaita semuti padetritusi zvirimwa. Isiri iyo, alge dzakafa dzaisagara nguva ndefu.

98.body: Thermus aquaticus thermophile kubva mumvura dzinopisa dzinobuda muvhu. Taq polymerase ndiyo bazisi rePCR. Mudziva coneja inenge yorara.

99.body: Deinococcus radiodurans ndiyo champiri yemajonjensi (radiation). Inogadzirasa jenomu yakaputsika maawa mashoma. Huswa hukobvu, tetradi dze seli.

1001.body: Sexual Eukaryote muenzaniso wekudzidzisa kudyarirana. Mutezo wemihariri maviri, kusangana kwegametes, asiri kupatsanura kwoga kwakapusa.

T4 Bacteriophage.body: T4 myovirus hombe yaE. coli. Mutsipa unomanikidza uchinodzeredza DNA. Muhafu ye awa seli inobvaruka, maphage mazhinji anobuda.

Lambda Phage.body: Lambda phage inogona kurarama nemamwe. Inogona kupinda muchromosome ikazorora (lysogeny) kana kucheka seli ipapo (lysis).

T7 Bacteriophage.body: T7 ine mutsipa mupfava uye inodzokorora zvikurumidza. Sisitimu inofarirwa mubayoloji we synthetic.

Phi-6 Phage.body: Phi-6 phage yeRNA ine envelope yelipid. Inorwisa Pseudomonas. Membrane inowanikwa zvikishoma kubva kumaphage.

MS2 Phage.body: MS2 phage yeRNA diki isina mutsipa. Inobatira pili ya E. coli yerume. Jenomu yayo yaiva imwe yejenomu dzeRNA dzokutanga kuwerengwa.

Neuro-Parasite.body: Neuro-paramita yekunyoredwa yemudziva. Inobatira paeukaryote uye inoputsa maitiro emuridzi kusvika muridzi ava mutakuri.

Sexual Eukaryote.body: Sexual Eukaryote muenzaniso wekudzidzisa kudyarirana. Mutezo wemihariri maviri, kusangana kwegametes, asiri kupatsanura kwoga kwakapusa.
